items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24

ctx.x: Those old people, they come and they go. The names come and go. But anyway, he was an old Frenchman. And my grandmother was a nurse. She spoke French. His wife had cancer. And he called her in to take care of his wife and his children. We had four children. And she died. My grandmother still stayed there and took care of the children, boys, the four daughters. They adored my grandmother. They did everything for her. Everything. One of them was a lawyer. The other two were something. But anyway, they took care of…
I know some Bartons, but I don't know if they are the same kind.
